blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解污染控制策略 (CCS) 各項要素的實務考量重點
blocks.en: Understand the key practical considerations for each element of the contamination control strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: 掌握封閉製程與開放製程在污染防護上的根本差異
blocks.en: Grasp the fundamental difference between closed and open processes in contamination protection

blocks.zh: 認識一次性設備與可重複使用設備在污染控制方面的優劣
blocks.en: Recognize the advantages and disadvantages of single-use and reusable equipment for contamination control

blocks.zh: 了解物料、設備、人員動線管理對於防止污染的重要性
blocks.en: Understand the importance of managing the flow of materials, equipment, and personnel to prevent contamination

blocks.zh: 學習維護作業、更衣程序、清潔與滅菌等實務要求
blocks.en: Learn the practical requirements for maintenance activities, gowning procedures, cleaning, and sterilization

blocks.zh: 理解藥物物質 (DS) 與藥品 (DP) 組成對微生物控制的影響
blocks.en: Understand how the composition of the drug substance (DS) and drug product (DP) affects microbial control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析
blocks.en: Core Concepts

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS (污染控制策略)：這是 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 所強調的核心文件，要求製造商以全面性、系統性的方式識別和管控所有污染來源。本附錄將 CCS 的各項要素以實務表格呈現，是建構 CCS 文件的最佳參考範本。
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS: This is the core document emphasized in EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), which requires manufacturers to identify and control all sources of contamination in a comprehensive, systematic way. This appendix presents the individual elements of a CCS as practical tables and is an excellent reference template for building a CCS document.

blocks.zh: 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: 本附錄共包含 Tables 15.0-1 至 15.0-8（原文提及至 15.0-10，此處涵蓋前八張表），每張表針對 CCS 的一個特定面向提供實務指引，並在最後列出「預防污染的效益」(Benefit to Preventing Contamination)。閱讀時建議先看效益說明，再回頭理解各項實務要求的邏輯。
blocks.en: This appendix contains Tables 15.0-1 to 15.0-8 (the report refers to tables up to 15.0-10; the first eight are covered here). Each table gives practical guidance on one specific aspect of the CCS and ends with a statement of the "Benefit to Preventing Contamination". When reading, it helps to start with the benefit statement and then go back to understand the logic behind each practical requirement.

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-1🔍: Structure of the Manufacturing Areas Table 15.0-1🔍: 生產區域結構
blocks.en: Table 15.0-1🔍: Structure of the Manufacturing Areas🔍

blocks.zh: Closed Process (封閉製程)：指製程中產品與外部環境之間存在完整的物理屏障。物料進出僅透過封閉連接器 (closed connectors)，人員不直接接觸產品或產品接觸表面。這是最強大的污染控制工程措施。
blocks.en: Closed Process: A process in which a complete physical barrier separates the product from the external environment. Materials enter and leave only through closed connectors, and personnel have no direct contact with the product or product-contact surfaces. This is the most powerful engineering measure for contamination control.

blocks.zh: Open Process (開放製程)：製程中產品暴露於周圍環境，必須依賴多重屏障（更衣、無菌操作訓練、氣流控制等）來防護。開放製程的污染風險顯著高於封閉製程。
blocks.en: Open Process: A process in which the product is exposed to the surrounding environment and must be protected by multiple barriers (gowning, aseptic technique training, airflow control, etc.). The contamination risk of an open process is significantly higher than that of a closed process.

blocks.zh: Single-Use Equipment (一次性設備)：使用後即丟棄，消除了因清洗不徹底而導致的交叉污染風險。其完整性可透過微生物侵入測試 (microbial ingress test) 來驗證，偵測靈敏度達 1-3 μm。
blocks.en: Single-Use Equipment: Equipment that is discarded after use, which eliminates the risk of cross-contamination caused by inadequate cleaning. Its integrity can be verified by a microbial ingress test, with a detection sensitivity of 1-3 μm.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像封閉製程就像太空站：所有物資透過密封艙門傳入，內部與外部完全隔絕，太空人不需要擔心外面的真空環境。而開放製程則像在露天市場準備食物：必須靠帳篷、防風罩、手套、口罩等多重防護來減少灰塵和污染。
blocks.en: Think of a closed process as a space station: all supplies come in through sealed hatches, the inside is completely isolated from the outside, and the astronauts need not worry about the vacuum beyond. An open process is like preparing food at an open-air market: you must rely on multiple protections such as tents, windshields, gloves, and masks to reduce dust and contamination.

blocks.zh: 一次性設備就像免洗餐具：用完即丟，不必擔心洗碗是否洗乾淨。可重複使用設備則像餐廳瓷器：經濟實惠但必須確保每次清洗都達到衛生標準。
blocks.en: Single-use equipment is like disposable tableware: use it once and throw it away, with no need to worry whether the dishes were washed properly. Reusable equipment is like restaurant china: economical, but every wash must meet hygiene standards.

blocks.zh: 本表的核心訊息是：封閉製程 + 一次性設備 = 最理想的端到端 (end-to-end) 污染控制設計。
blocks.en: The key message of this table is: closed process + single-use equipment = the ideal end-to-end contamination control design.

blocks.zh: 特別注意對於生物製品：種子庫 (seed stocks) 和細胞庫 (cell stocks) 的操作，以及無菌試驗 (sterility test) 的執行，報告明確指出隔離器技術 (isolator technology) 是首選設備。這反映了 EU GMP Annex 1 對無菌測試環境的嚴格要求。
blocks.en: A special note for biological products: for the handling of seed stocks and cell stocks, and for the performance of sterility tests, the report explicitly states that isolator technology is the preferred equipment. This reflects the strict requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 for the sterility testing environment.

blocks.zh: 可重複使用設備的一個關鍵弱點：組裝後無法方便地驗證系統完整性。壓力保持測試 (pressure-hold test) 只是常用方法，但不能確認系統完全密封。
blocks.en: A key weakness of reusable equipment: system integrity cannot be conveniently verified after assembly. A pressure-hold test is a commonly used method, but it cannot confirm that the system is completely sealed.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 設施設計時，應優先考慮從原料藥 (DS) 下游純化步驟開始，到成品 (DP) 充填封裝為止，全程採用封閉系統搭配一次性設備。這不僅降低污染風險，也大幅簡化清潔確效 (cleaning validation) 的負擔，縮短批次切換時間。
blocks.en: When designing a CDMO facility, give priority to using closed systems with single-use equipment all the way from the downstream purification steps of the drug substance (DS) through to fill and finish of the drug product (DP). This not only lowers contamination risk but also greatly simplifies the cleaning validation burden and shortens batch changeover time.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼報告指出「壓力保持測試不能確認系統完整性」？這對可重複使用設備的風險評估有什麼意義？
blocks.en: Why does the report state that "a pressure-hold test cannot confirm system integrity"? What does this mean for the risk assessment of reusable equipment?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，開放製程仍然是不可避免的？此時應如何建構多重屏障？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances is an open process still unavoidable? How should multiple barriers be built in that case?

blocks.zh: 一次性設備的微生物侵入測試偵測靈敏度為 1-3 μm，這個數值在微生物學上代表什麼意義？
blocks.en: The detection sensitivity of the microbial ingress test for single-use equipment is 1-3 μm. What does this value mean in microbiological terms?

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-2🔍: Multiuse or Single-Product Facility Table 15.0-2🔍: 多用途或單一產品廠房
blocks.en: Table 15.0-2🔍: Multiuse or Single-Product Facility🔍

blocks.zh: Multiuse Facility (多產品設施)：在同一設施中製造多種產品。需要特別注意交叉污染防護，尤其是生物製品中外來因子 (adventitious agents) 和病毒的控制。
blocks.en: Multiuse Facility: A facility in which multiple products are manufactured. Special attention must be paid to cross-contamination prevention, particularly the control of adventitious agents and viruses in biological products.

blocks.zh: Adulterated (摻雜/劣化)：當產品因為非預期的雜質引入而品質受損時，無論污染來源為何，該產品即被視為「摻雜」，在法規上屬於嚴重違規。
blocks.en: Adulterated: When product quality is compromised by the introduction of unintended impurities, the product is considered "adulterated" regardless of the source of contamination, which is a serious violation from a regulatory standpoint.

blocks.zh: 多產品設施就像一間供應多種料理的中央廚房：即使廚房很大，如果不嚴格區隔工作區域，海鮮的過敏原可能污染到素食料理。單一產品設施則像只做一種甜點的專賣店：交叉污染風險天然較低，但仍需注意不同批次間的品質控制。
blocks.en: A multiuse facility is like a central kitchen serving many kinds of dishes: however large the kitchen is, if work areas are not strictly separated, seafood allergens could contaminate vegetarian dishes. A single-product facility is like a shop that makes only one dessert: the cross-contamination risk is naturally lower, but quality control between batches still needs attention.

blocks.zh: 報告特別強調：無論是多產品還是單一產品設施，污染防護的基本要求是一樣的。不能因為是單一產品設施就放鬆警覺。從上游操作單元不慎引入的雜質，在任何情況下都是不可接受的。
blocks.en: The report emphasizes: whether the facility is multiuse or single-product, the basic requirements for contamination prevention are the same. Vigilance must not be relaxed just because a facility makes a single product. Impurities inadvertently introduced from upstream unit operations are unacceptable under any circumstances.

blocks.zh: 對於生物製品的多產品設施，區域隔離 (segregation) 是確保下游物料的外來因子和病毒控制的關鍵措施。
blocks.en: For multiuse facilities handling biological products, segregation of areas is the key measure for ensuring control of adventitious agents and viruses in downstream materials.

blocks.zh: CDMO 作為代工製造商，通常營運多產品設施。針對生物製品的 CCS，哪些設施設計特徵對防止交叉污染最為關鍵？
blocks.en: A CDMO, as a contract manufacturer, usually operates multiuse facilities. For a CCS for biological products, which facility design features are most critical for preventing cross-contamination?

blocks.zh: 為什麼報告說單一產品設施與多產品設施在污染控制上的差異「相當微妙」？
blocks.en: Why does the report say that the difference in contamination control between single-product and multiuse facilities is "subtle"?

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-3🔍: Storage of Materials and Equipment Table 15.0-3🔍: 物料與設備之儲存
blocks.en: Table 15.0-3🔍: Storage of Materials and Equipment🔍

blocks.zh: Sterile Hold Time (無菌保持時間)：指設備經滅菌後，在使用前可以存放的最長時間。超過此時間，設備需要重新滅菌。這個時間必須經過確效 (validation) 才能確立。
blocks.en: Sterile Hold Time: The maximum time that equipment may be stored after sterilization before use. Beyond this time, the equipment must be re-sterilized. This time must be established through validation.

blocks.zh: Microbial Proliferation (微生物增殖)：當儲存條件（溫度、濕度、營養）適合微生物生長時，即使初始微生物負荷 (bioburden) 很低，也可能在存放期間大量增殖。
blocks.en: Microbial Proliferation: When storage conditions (temperature, humidity, nutrients) support microbial growth, even a very low initial bioburden may multiply substantially during storage.

blocks.zh: 物料儲存管理就像家庭冰箱管理：食材必須密封保存、控制溫度、定期檢查，否則細菌會繁殖導致食物腐敗。設備的無菌保持時間就像便當的保鮮期限：過了期限就不能再食用，必須重新製作。
blocks.en: Managing the storage of materials is like managing a household refrigerator: food must be sealed, the temperature controlled, and the contents checked regularly, or bacteria will multiply and the food will spoil. The sterile hold time of equipment is like the shelf life of a packed lunch: once it expires, it can no longer be used and must be prepared again.

blocks.zh: 取樣和分裝區域「不應增加原料的微生物負荷」，這看似簡單的要求，實際上需要嚴格的環境控制和操作程序。許多污染事件正是發生在取樣或分裝環節。
blocks.en: Sampling and dispensing areas "should not increase the bioburden of raw materials". This seemingly simple requirement in practice calls for strict environmental control and operating procedures. Many contamination events occur precisely during sampling or dispensing.

blocks.zh: 已清潔設備的儲存也需要確效：確認在儲存期間微生物負荷和內毒素水平不會增加。這通常涉及定期監測和定義最長儲存時間。
blocks.en: Storage of cleaned equipment also requires validation: confirm that bioburden and endotoxin levels do not increase during storage. This usually involves periodic monitoring and a defined maximum storage time.

blocks.zh: 為什麼儲存條件需要同時控制溫度和濕度？高濕度環境會帶來哪些微生物風險？
blocks.en: Why do storage conditions need to control both temperature and humidity? What microbial risks does a high-humidity environment bring?

blocks.zh: 如果一台已滅菌的設備超過了驗證的無菌保持時間，應該採取什麼措施？
blocks.en: If a sterilized piece of equipment exceeds its validated sterile hold time, what action should be taken?

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-4🔍: Path of Materials, Equipment, or Waste Table 15.0-4🔍: 物料、設備或廢棄物之流向
blocks.en: Table 15.0-4🔍: Path of Materials, Equipment, or Waste🔍

blocks.zh: Unidirectional Flow (單向流)：物料、人員和廢棄物均依照單一方向移動，避免清潔物品與污染物品的路徑交叉。這是設施設計的基本原則。
blocks.en: Unidirectional Flow: Materials, personnel, and waste all move in a single direction, so that the paths of clean items and contaminated items never cross. This is a basic principle of facility design.

blocks.zh: Sporicide (芽孢殺滅劑)：能夠殺滅細菌芽孢的消毒劑。一般消毒劑可能無法有效殺滅芽孢，因此在需要高度消毒的場合必須使用芽孢殺滅劑。
blocks.en: Sporicide: A disinfectant capable of killing bacterial spores. General disinfectants may not kill spores effectively, so a sporicide must be used wherever a high level of disinfection is required.

blocks.zh: Pass-through Autoclave (穿越式高壓滅菌鍋)：安裝在潔淨區與非潔淨區之間牆壁上的滅菌設備，廢棄物從潔淨側裝入、滅菌後從非潔淨側取出，避免污染路徑逆行。
blocks.en: Pass-through Autoclave: A sterilizer installed in the wall between a clean area and an unclassified area. Waste is loaded from the clean side and, after sterilization, removed from the unclassified side, which avoids a backward contamination path.

blocks.zh: 物料動線管理就像機場安檢流程：旅客和行李各有專屬通道；進入管制區前必須層層檢查（脫去外包裝 = 脫鞋過安檢）；垃圾有專門的出口，絕不能逆行回到候機大廳。紙箱、木材等不能消毒的包裝材料就像禁止攜帶的危險物品，絕對不允許進入潔淨區。
blocks.en: Managing the flow of materials is like an airport security process: passengers and baggage each have a dedicated route; checks must be passed layer by layer before entering the controlled area (removing outer packaging = taking off shoes at security); waste has its own exit and must never flow back into the departure hall. Packaging materials that cannot be disinfected, such as cardboard and wood, are like prohibited dangerous items and must never be allowed into the clean area.

blocks.zh: 幾個容易被忽略的實務要點：
blocks.en: A few practical points that are easily overlooked:

blocks.zh: 物料絕不接觸地面：地面是微生物負荷最高的表面
blocks.en: Materials must never touch the floor: the floor is the surface with the highest bioburden

blocks.zh: 推車的輪子也要消毒：輪子接觸地面，是污染傳播的重要途徑
blocks.en: Cart wheels must also be disinfected: wheels contact the floor and are an important route for spreading contamination

blocks.zh: 推車最好專用於特定潔淨度等級區域：進一步降低跨區域污染風險
blocks.en: Carts should preferably be dedicated to areas of a specific cleanliness grade: this further reduces the risk of cross-area contamination

blocks.zh: 人員氣鎖與物料氣鎖分開：人是最大的污染源，必須與物料路徑隔離
blocks.en: Personnel airlocks and material airlocks should be separate: people are the biggest source of contamination and must be separated from material paths

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 設施設計審查 (design review) 中，應繪製完整的物料流、人員流和廢棄物流平面圖，確認三者路徑不交叉。每個分級邊界 (classification border) 的傳遞程序都應書面化並包含消毒步驟。
blocks.en: In a CDMO facility design review, complete floor plans of material flow, personnel flow, and waste flow should be drawn to confirm that the three paths do not cross. The transfer procedure at each classification border should be documented and include a disinfection step.

blocks.zh: 為什麼紙箱、木材和開孔泡棉被禁止帶入潔淨區？從微粒和微生物的角度分析。
blocks.en: Why are cardboard, wood, and open-cell foam prohibited from entering the clean area? Analyze from the standpoint of particles and microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 在設計廢棄物路徑時，穿越式高壓滅菌鍋應安裝在什麼位置才能「最大限度減少不必要的暴露」？
blocks.en: When designing the waste path, where should a pass-through autoclave be installed to "minimize unnecessary exposure"?

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-5🔍: Maintenance Table 15.0-5🔍: 維護保養
blocks.en: Table 15.0-5🔍: Maintenance🔍

blocks.zh: EM (Environmental Monitoring，環境監測)：對潔淨區的空氣微粒、浮游菌和沉降菌進行定期取樣和監測的活動。維護完成後的環境監測是確認區域可安全恢復使用的關鍵步驟。
blocks.en: EM (Environmental Monitoring): The periodic sampling and monitoring of airborne particles, viable air, and settle plates in clean areas. Environmental monitoring after maintenance is a key step in confirming that the area can safely be returned to use.

blocks.zh: Return to Service (恢復使用)：維護活動完成後，需要經過清潔、消毒、環境監測等一系列驗收程序，確認環境恢復到符合要求的狀態後，才能重新投入生產使用。
blocks.en: Return to Service: After maintenance activities are completed, a series of acceptance procedures such as cleaning, disinfection, and environmental monitoring is required to confirm that the environment has returned to the required state before it is put back into production.

blocks.zh: 維護作業就像在醫院手術室進行管線維修：維修工人不熟悉無菌規範，攜帶的工具可能沾有灰塵和微生物，維修過程可能產生碎屑。因此，維修前要覆蓋設備（就像手術時鋪無菌布），維修後要徹底清潔消毒並檢查環境（就像手術室終末消毒後需要環境採樣確認）。
blocks.en: Maintenance is like repairing pipework in a hospital operating room: the repair workers are unfamiliar with aseptic rules, the tools they bring may carry dust and microorganisms, and the repair may generate debris. Therefore, equipment must be covered before the repair (like draping sterile sheets during surgery), and after the repair the area must be thoroughly cleaned and disinfected and the environment checked (like environmental sampling to confirm the operating room after terminal disinfection).

blocks.zh: 維護作業是污染控制中最常被低估的風險來源之一。報告明確指出：
blocks.en: Maintenance is one of the most underestimated sources of risk in contamination control. The report explicitly points out:

blocks.zh: 維護帶入的非常規設備和材料可能超越正常控制措施的承受能力 (overchallenge)
blocks.en: Non-routine equipment and materials brought in for maintenance may exceed the capacity of the normal control measures (overchallenge)

blocks.zh: 維護人員可能對潔淨室行為規範和基礎微生物學缺乏認知
blocks.en: Maintenance personnel may lack awareness of cleanroom behavior rules and basic microbiology

blocks.zh: 承包商也必須納入培訓計畫
blocks.en: Contractors must also be included in the training program

blocks.zh: 氧化性芽孢殺滅劑會腐蝕金屬表面並損壞牆壁和地面，不能不沖洗就頻繁使用
blocks.en: Oxidizing sporicides corrode metal surfaces and damage walls and floors, and must not be used frequently without rinsing

blocks.zh: 報告參考 Section 17.0 附錄三中的案例研究 #4，建議讀者深入了解維護後污染的實際案例。
blocks.en: The report refers to Case Study #4 in Appendix 3 (Section 17.0) and recommends that readers study this real-world example of post-maintenance contamination.

blocks.zh: 建議將常用維護零件和工具預先存放在潔淨區內的專用推車上，減少頻繁從非潔淨區轉入的風險。每次維護作業前擬定作業計畫 (maintenance plan)，載明：需要的工具和零件清單、預期影響的區域、覆蓋/保護措施、清潔消毒程序、恢復使用的驗收標準（包括 EM 合格標準）。
blocks.en: It is advisable to pre-stock commonly used maintenance parts and tools on a dedicated cart inside the clean area, reducing the risk of frequent transfers from the unclassified area. Before each maintenance activity, prepare a maintenance plan that states: the list of tools and parts required, the areas expected to be affected, covering/protection measures, cleaning and disinfection procedures, and acceptance criteria for return to service (including EM acceptance criteria).

blocks.zh: 為什麼報告建議將常用維護零件存放在潔淨區內？這與物料傳遞管控有什麼關聯？
blocks.en: Why does the report recommend storing commonly used maintenance parts inside the clean area? How does this relate to control of material transfer?

blocks.zh: 恢復使用 (return to service) 的程序應該包含哪些步驟？這些步驟的嚴格程度應基於什麼原則？
blocks.en: What steps should the return-to-service procedure include? On what principle should the stringency of these steps be based?

blocks.zh: 在選擇消毒劑時，為什麼需要考慮表面材質和使用頻率？舉例說明不當選擇的後果。
blocks.en: When selecting a disinfectant, why must the surface material and frequency of use be considered? Give an example of the consequences of an inappropriate choice.

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-6🔍: Movement and Gowning of Personnel Table 15.0-6🔍: 人員動線與著裝
blocks.en: Table 15.0-6🔍: Movement and Gowning of Personnel🔍

blocks.zh: Aseptic Practices (無菌操作規範)：一套訓練有素的行為準則，確保操作人員在無菌環境中的每個動作都不會引入污染。包括正確的手部動作、物品傳遞方式、身體姿態等。
blocks.en: Aseptic Practices: A set of trained behavioral rules that ensure every movement of the operator in the aseptic environment does not introduce contamination. They include correct hand movements, methods of passing items, body posture, and so on.

blocks.zh: Gowning Qualification (更衣資格確認)：操作人員必須通過更衣考核，證明其穿著無菌服裝後，身體表面的微生物負荷符合規定標準。這是進入潔淨區的先決條件。
blocks.en: Gowning Qualification: Operators must pass a gowning assessment demonstrating that, after donning sterile garments, the microbial load on their body surfaces meets the specified standard. This is a prerequisite for entering the clean area.

blocks.zh: 人員更衣流程就像進入醫院手術室的更衣程序：從停車場出發，經過公共區域，到達更衣室，逐層更換衣物（去除外套 → 換手術衣 → 戴口罩手套），每一層氣鎖就是一個「換裝站」。報告特別提到停車場、公共空間和洗手間都是污染源，就像提醒外科醫生：你身上帶著外面世界的所有微生物。
blocks.en: The gowning flow for personnel is like the changing procedure for entering a hospital operating room: starting from the car park, passing through public areas, and arriving at the changing room, clothing is changed layer by layer (remove outer coat → put on surgical gown → put on mask and gloves), and each airlock is a "changing station". The report specifically mentions that car parks, public spaces, and restrooms are all sources of contamination, much like reminding a surgeon: you carry all the microorganisms of the outside world on you.

blocks.zh: 人類是無菌製程中最常見的污染來源——這是本表最核心的訊息。所有關於更衣、氣鎖、單向流和無菌操作的要求，本質上都是為了在人員與產品之間建立有效屏障。
blocks.en: Humans are the most common source of contamination in aseptic processes - this is the core message of this table. All the requirements on gowning, airlocks, unidirectional flow, and aseptic practices are essentially about establishing an effective barrier between personnel and product.

blocks.zh: 一個容易忽略的細節：不同更衣要求的人員不應同時出現在同一區域（例如物料氣鎖內）。這是因為更衣等級較低的人員可能會將較高級別的污染傳播到較潔淨的區域。
blocks.en: An easily overlooked detail: personnel with different gowning requirements should not be present in the same area at the same time (for example, inside a material airlock). This is because personnel in a lower gowning level may carry contamination of a higher level into the cleaner area.

blocks.zh: 為什麼氣鎖被描述為「可能受污染衣物和手套的終止點」？這個概念對氣鎖設計有什麼指導意義？
blocks.en: Why is an airlock described as "an end point for potentially contaminated garments and gloves"? What does this concept imply for airlock design?

blocks.zh: 如何設計人員動線，確保從停車場到潔淨室的路徑中，污染風險逐步降低？
blocks.en: How should personnel flow be designed so that the contamination risk decreases step by step along the path from the car park to the cleanroom?

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-7🔍: Composition of DS and DP Table 15.0-7🔍: 原料藥（DS）與藥品（DP）組成
blocks.en: Table 15.0-7🔍: Composition of DS and DP🔍

blocks.zh: Water Activity (水活性, aw)：衡量物料中可供微生物利用的水分量。水活性越高（接近 1.0），越適合微生物生長。乾燥粉末的水活性低，微生物不易生長；而緩衝液和培養基的水活性高，是微生物的天然培養基。
blocks.en: Water Activity (aw): A measure of the amount of water in a material that is available to microorganisms. The higher the water activity (approaching 1.0), the more suitable the material is for microbial growth. Dry powders have low water activity and do not readily support microbial growth, whereas buffers and culture media have high water activity and are natural growth media for microorganisms.

blocks.zh: Enveloped Viruses (包膜病毒)：具有脂質外膜的病毒，對低 pH 和界面活性劑 (detergent) 處理較為敏感。常見的病毒滅活步驟（如 low pH hold 或 solvent/detergent treatment）主要針對這類病毒。
blocks.en: Enveloped Viruses: Viruses with a lipid outer membrane, which are relatively sensitive to low pH and detergent treatment. Common viral inactivation steps (such as a low pH hold or solvent/detergent treatment) mainly target this type of virus.

blocks.zh: Nanofiltration (奈米過濾)：使用孔徑約 20 nm 的濾膜，可有效去除包括小型非包膜病毒在內的病毒顆粒。這是生物製品製程中重要的病毒去除步驟。
blocks.en: Nanofiltration: Filtration using membranes with a pore size of about 20 nm, which effectively removes virus particles, including small non-enveloped viruses. This is an important virus removal step in biological product processes.

blocks.zh: 理解產品組成對微生物風險的影響，就像評估不同食物的變質風險：牛奶（高營養、高水活性）放在室溫下幾小時就會變質，而乾燥餅乾（低水活性）可以放很久。生物製品製程中，富含營養的培養基和緩衝液就是微生物的「美食」，必須特別注意保持時間 (hold time) 的管控。
blocks.en: Understanding how product composition affects microbial risk is like assessing the spoilage risk of different foods: milk (high in nutrients, high water activity) spoils within hours at room temperature, whereas dry crackers (low water activity) keep for a long time. In a biological product process, nutrient-rich culture media and buffers are the microbial "feast", and hold times must be controlled with particular care.

blocks.zh: 本表的核心理念是「了解製程中的脆弱點」(vulnerable points)。不是所有製程步驟的微生物風險都一樣高。通過分析中間體和緩衝液的組成（營養含量、pH、水活性），可以識別出哪些步驟特別容易受到微生物污染，從而針對性地建構控制措施。
blocks.en: The core idea of this table is to "understand the vulnerable points in the process". Not all process steps carry the same microbial risk. By analyzing the composition of intermediates and buffers (nutrient content, pH, water activity), it is possible to identify which steps are especially susceptible to microbial contamination and to build targeted controls.

blocks.zh: 特別需要注意：引入促進微生物生長的物料後，下游應立即安排微生物負荷/內毒素去除步驟（過濾、滅菌等）作為安全保障。
blocks.en: Special note: after a material that promotes microbial growth is introduced, a bioburden/endotoxin removal step (filtration, sterilization, etc.) should be scheduled immediately downstream as a safeguard.

blocks.zh: 在單株抗體 (mAb) 製程中，從細胞培養到純化的各步驟，哪些中間體最容易支持微生物生長？
blocks.en: In a monoclonal antibody (mAb) process, which intermediates, from cell culture through purification, are most likely to support microbial growth?

blocks.zh: 低 pH 病毒滅活步驟主要針對包膜病毒有效，那對於非包膜病毒應如何控制？
blocks.en: The low pH viral inactivation step is mainly effective against enveloped viruses. How should non-enveloped viruses be controlled?

blocks.zh: 為什麼報告將延長保持時間描述為「對污染的脆弱性」？如何設定合理的保持時間限制？
blocks.en: Why does the report describe extended hold times as a "vulnerability to contamination"? How can reasonable hold time limits be set?

blocks.zh: Table 15.0-8🔍: Cleaning and Sterilization Processes Table 15.0-8🔍: 清潔與滅菌製程
blocks.en: Table 15.0-8🔍: Cleaning and Sterilization Processes🔍

blocks.zh: Manual Cleaning (人工清洗)：依賴操作人員手動進行的清洗程序。與自動化 CIP (Clean-In-Place，就地清洗) 相比，人工清洗的再現性 (reproducibility) 較差，因為清洗效果取決於個人操作，很難確保每次都達到相同標準。
blocks.en: Manual Cleaning: A cleaning procedure that relies on operators performing the cleaning by hand. Compared with automated CIP (Clean-In-Place), manual cleaning has poorer reproducibility, because the cleaning result depends on the individual operator and it is difficult to guarantee the same standard every time.

blocks.zh: One-way Autoclave (單向高壓滅菌鍋)：安裝在不同潔淨度等級區域之間，物品從低潔淨側裝入、滅菌後從高潔淨側取出。這確保已滅菌物品不會與未滅菌物品交叉接觸。
blocks.en: One-way Autoclave: An autoclave installed between areas of different cleanliness grades, loaded from the lower-grade side and unloaded from the higher-grade side after sterilization. This ensures that sterilized items never come into cross-contact with unsterilized items.

blocks.zh: 人工清洗設備就像手洗碗盤 vs. 使用洗碗機：手洗的清潔程度因人而異，可能有些角落沒洗到；洗碗機（CIP）則每次都用相同的溫度、水壓和清潔劑，確保一致的清洗品質。這就是為什麼報告強調人工清洗「很難確保再現性」。
blocks.en: Manual cleaning of equipment is like washing dishes by hand versus using a dishwasher: the cleanliness of hand washing varies from person to person and some corners may be missed, whereas a dishwasher (CIP) uses the same temperature, water pressure, and detergent every time to ensure consistent cleaning quality. This is why the report stresses that manual cleaning makes reproducibility "difficult to ensure".

blocks.zh: 清潔和滅菌流程的設計不僅是操作層面的問題，也是設施設計的問題。報告指出，設施設計時就應考慮：
blocks.en: The design of cleaning and sterilization processes is not only an operational matter but also a facility design matter. The report points out that the following should already be considered during facility design:

blocks.zh: 單向高壓滅菌鍋 (one-way autoclave) 的位置安排
blocks.en: The location of the one-way autoclave

blocks.zh: 去熱原隧道 (depyrogenation tunnel) 的動線
blocks.en: The flow path of the depyrogenation tunnel

blocks.zh: 已滅菌設備的儲存環境等級
blocks.en: The grade of the storage environment for sterilized equipment

blocks.zh: 設備的維護、校準、確效和再確認需求
blocks.en: Equipment maintenance, calibration, validation, and requalification needs

blocks.zh: 這些都應在設施規劃階段就納入考量，而非事後補救。
blocks.en: All of these should be considered at the facility planning stage rather than remedied afterwards.

blocks.zh: 在 CCS 文件中，應清楚記錄每項設備的清洗方式（人工/CIP）、清洗確效狀態、滅菌方式（高壓蒸氣/乾熱/化學）、滅菌確效參數，以及相關設備（滅菌鍋、隧道等）的維護校準計畫。人工清洗的設備應特別加強確效監測，考慮增加目視檢查和化學殘留測試的頻率。
blocks.en: The CCS document should clearly record, for each piece of equipment, the cleaning method (manual/CIP), cleaning validation status, sterilization method (steam/dry heat/chemical), sterilization validation parameters, and the maintenance and calibration plan for the related equipment (autoclaves, tunnels, etc.). For manually cleaned equipment, validation monitoring should be strengthened, and consideration given to increasing the frequency of visual inspection and chemical residue testing.

blocks.zh: 為什麼人工清洗過程「很難確保再現性」？在無法避免人工清洗的情況下，可以採取哪些措施來提高一致性？
blocks.en: Why is it "difficult to ensure reproducibility" in manual cleaning? Where manual cleaning cannot be avoided, what measures can improve consistency?

blocks.zh: 設施設計中如何確保滅菌過程的每個階段都能防止污染引入？舉出至少三個設計要素。
blocks.en: How can facility design ensure that every stage of the sterilization process prevents the introduction of contamination? Give at least three design elements.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 封閉製程 + 一次性設備是最強大的污染控制組合，理想的端到端設計應從 DS 純化步驟一直延伸到 DP 充填封裝。
blocks.en: Closed process + single-use equipment is the most powerful contamination control combination; the ideal end-to-end design should extend from the DS purification steps all the way to DP fill and finish.

blocks.zh: 人類是最常見的污染源：所有關於更衣、氣鎖、人員動線的設計要求，本質上都是在建立人與產品之間的有效屏障。
blocks.en: Humans are the most common source of contamination: all design requirements for gowning, airlocks, and personnel flow are essentially about establishing an effective barrier between people and product.

blocks.zh: 維護作業是高風險事件：非常規設備和材料的引入可能超越正常控制措施的承受能力，需要完善的培訓、程序和恢復使用驗收標準。
blocks.en: Maintenance is a high-risk event: the introduction of non-routine equipment and materials may exceed the capacity of the normal control measures, so sound training, procedures, and acceptance criteria for return to service are needed.

blocks.zh: 物料動線管理遵循單向流原則，物料氣鎖與人員氣鎖分離，紙箱/木材等不可消毒材料禁止進入潔淨區。
blocks.en: Management of material flow follows the principle of unidirectional flow, with material airlocks separated from personnel airlocks, and non-disinfectable materials such as cardboard and wood prohibited from entering the clean area.

blocks.zh: 產品組成影響微生物風險：應分析中間體和緩衝液的營養含量、pH 和水活性，識別製程中的脆弱點，針對性配置微生物負荷去除和病毒去除步驟。
blocks.en: Product composition affects microbial risk: analyze the nutrient content, pH, and water activity of intermediates and buffers to identify vulnerable points in the process, and place bioburden removal and virus removal steps accordingly.

blocks.zh: 清潔與滅菌不僅是操作問題，也是設施設計問題。人工清洗的再現性較差，應在設計階段就規劃單向滅菌鍋和適當的儲存環境。
blocks.en: Cleaning and sterilization is not only an operational issue but also a facility design issue. Manual cleaning has poorer reproducibility, so one-way autoclaves and appropriate storage environments should be planned at the design stage.

blocks.zh: 每張實務考量表的最後都列出「預防污染的效益」，這些效益說明為什麼需要實施各項控制措施，是撰寫 CCS 文件時的重要參考。
blocks.en: Every practical-considerations table ends with a "Benefit to Preventing Contamination" statement. These benefits explain why each control measure needs to be implemented and are an important reference when writing a CCS document.
